### The Fall of Babylon
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-fall-of-babylon
Passage: Revelation 18:9-24
Points:
- Babylon's collapse brings severe economic ruin, leading worldly rulers and merchants to lament their lost prosperity.
- Instead of turning to God in repentance during judgment, the impenitent mourn only their loss of earthly comforts.
- God's people are called to rejoice because the oppressive, persecuting system has finally received divine justice.
- An angel casting a great stone into the sea demonstrates the irreversible and violent end of worldly opposition to God.
- Financial instability should serve as a wake-up call to turn away from materialism and place ultimate trust in Christ.
